# Architecture Documentation

This directory contains auto-generated architecture documentation for the Nexus platform.

## Generated Files

- `*-docs.md` — Terraform module documentation generated by terraform-docs
- `resource-graph.mmd` — Mermaid diagram showing resource dependencies
- `network-topology.mmd` — Mermaid diagram showing network topology
- `iam-trust.mmd` — Mermaid diagram showing IAM trust relationships

## Generation

Run `make docs-generate` to regenerate all documentation.
